card.name: Adrenal insufficiency stress warning text
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "when" right after "signs and symptoms of adrenal insufficiency" in the corticosteroid HPA suppression warning. It also fires on nearby words in that sentence and on a few scattered conditional words such as "unless".

modes.label: Corticosteroid withdrawal warning
modes.description: Words inside or right after the sentence about adrenal insufficiency when exposed to trauma, surgery or infection.
modes.example: patients may exhibit signs and symptoms of adrenal insufficiency<< when>> exposed to trauma, surgery, or infection

modes.label: Other conditional or section words
modes.description: Scattered single words such as "unless" after a verb, or a section number in a warning list.
